payload.claim: This line restates sha256 hashing as `hashlib.sha256(critic_export.encode()).hexdigest()` instead of calling `artifacts.hash_artifact(critic_export)`, which this same test file already imports and uses for exactly this assertion shape at lines 15958 and 15988 (`assert record["sha256"] == artifacts.hash_artifact(record["raw"])`). The repo's standing rule is that a helper the repo already defines is imported rather than restated, even when the two computations agree today; `hash_artifact` could change its encoding or algorithm and this test would silently stop verifying the real behavior.
